title: Component tests assert visible output and mock hooks with the full return shape
answers: how to test a source model link fallback
test selects description row by position fails
test waits on react-query cache internals
body:
Convention from review of this PR: test what the user sees, not library internals.
- For fetch states, use msw handlers (ctx.delay for loading, ctx.status(404) for error) and wait on visible test IDs such as source-model-link or source-model-id. Do not read `getQueryCache()` state.
- In ModelVersionView.enzyme.test.tsx, mock the hook with a value typed `ReturnType<typeof useGetLoggedModelQuery>` that includes isLoading, isFetching, error and refetch. Do not cast a partial `{ data }` as any.
- Pick Descriptions rows by their label text (filterWhere on descriptions-item-label), not by positional .at(n), so inserting a row above does not break the test.
Files: mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry/components/ModelVersionSourceModelLink.test.tsx and ModelVersionView.enzyme.test.tsx.
applies: Jest/enzyme and msw tests for model registry version page components.
says: The model version page does not display the link to the source model.
The source model link displays an error state when the model cannot be found.
Add a fallback link when the source model cannot be found or loaded.
Insert a new metadata row above existing rows on the model version screen.
Show a loading indicator instead of blank text while fetching source model details.
search: Component tests for model registry version pages must assert visible DOM output and mock hooks with full return types rather than inspecting react-query cache internals or casting partial data. For fetch states, use msw handlers with ctx.delay for loading and ctx.status(404) for error, waiting on visible test IDs such as source-model-link or source-model-id instead of getQueryCache(). In ModelVersionView.enzyme.test.tsx, mock the hook with ReturnType<typeof useGetLoggedModelQuery> containing isLoading, isFetching, error, and refetch, without casting partial data as any. Select Descriptions rows by label text via filterWhere on descriptions-item-label instead of positional .at(n) indexing, applying to ModelVersionSourceModelLink.test.tsx and ModelVersionView.enzyme.test.tsx.
